children: Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:RIO) announced a 211.00 US cents interim ADR dividend for H1 to June 30 payable Sept 24, filed a $10bn EMTN Base Prospectus naming US finance vehicles as issuers with Rio Tinto plc/Ltd as guarantors, and will supply ELYSIS low‑carbon aluminum via Prysmian for an Amazon Ohio data‑center cable project.
: Rio Tinto (RIO) declared a 2026 interim dividend of 211.00 US cents per ADR for the half year to June 30, payable Sept 24, 2026; FX rates for GBP, AUD, NZD fixed Sept 15, 2026.
: Rio Tinto plc (RIO) filed a Base Prospectus dated 15 Sep 2026 for a $10bn Euro Medium Term Note programme, naming US finance vehicles as issuers and Rio Tinto plc/ Ltd as guarantors.
Low-Carbon Aluminum via Prysmian For Amazon DC

: Rio Tinto (RIO) will supply low‑carbon aluminum via Prysmian for electrical cables used at an Amazon data center near Columbus, Ohio, marking the first reported ELYSIS‑made aluminum data‑center use.
